QuestInfo.name: Fenelle's Concern 2
QuestInfo.0: Tell #p3000001# that the West Sanctum Sacred Stone has been stolen.
QuestInfo.1: The priests are debating what will happen to the Protective Shield with two of the four Sacred Stones missing. Please wait for them to finish deliberating.
QuestInfo.2: The Protective Shield is expected to weaken and disappear soon. The relic must be returned quickly, because Magnus will surely attack once the Protective Shield disappears.

0.0: I sensed the change in the energy that surrounds the Pantheon. Please calm yourself and tell me what happened.

yes.0: The West Sanctum Sacred Stone was taken. With that gone and the East Sanctum Sacred Stone attached to #p3000013#, the Protective Shield around Pantheon is failing.
yes.1: With only two Sacred Stones, I have serious doubts the Protective Shield will hold. I must discuss this matter with the chief priests. Please give me a moment.

no.0: Do not keep such concerns to yourself.

1.0: The priests have confirmed my worst fears. It is impossible to maintain the Protective Shield with only two Sacred Stones. When it falls, Darmoor's army will pass into Pantheon unhindered.

yes.0: Even if we reclaim the Sacred Stone and return it to the Sanctum, it needs time to recharge the Protective Shield. All we can do is recover the Sacred Stone as quickly as possible!
